baseline.method: Independent complete qualified author TV on final small-strain observations

selected_standard_method: qualified source TV, original99-update cap and original cost-increase/relative-cost stopping
reference_role: Actual simulated modulus, not a reconstruction or inferred calibration
nrmse_definition: sqrt(mean((estimate-reference)^2))/(max(reference)-min(reference)), all800 elements without alignment or scaling
relative_displacement_error_definition: L2 norm of independent FEM prediction minus public noisy displacement, divided by L2 norm of that displacement
maximum_abs_principal_strain_definition: Maximum absolute principal affine strain of independently predicted displacement over all800 P1 triangles; engineering shear divided by2

threshold_provenance.observation: 1.1 times complete qualified-source relative displacement error; reference exhibits regularization bias and this is not a chi-squared threshold
threshold_provenance.strain: Fixed small-strain applicability ceiling.01, selected before corrected physical acquisition generation

qualification: Current-vector central J, correct homogeneous grid index, public-noisy-data ad-hoc weights, fixed consistent quadratic barriers; all other selected TV conventions retained
